text:
talia: rolled microkernel-priority-lanes v3 to interactive clusters.

talia: short TL;DR: p99 down ~16% for interactive chat, median about the same, and token compute cost down ~11% across our sampled mix.

omar: can you paste the canary numbers?

talia: canary (90m): baseline p99 = 285ms -> v3 p99 = 240ms; p50 = 40ms -> 39ms. coalesce rate for eligible traffic improved 26% -> 53%.

vik: which models/routes were in scope and any exclusions?

talia: scoped: seq <= 128 interactive routes with prefix_kv enabled. models: rwd-chat-small, rwd-chat-medium, hosted-ggml-6b. excluded streaming-only and long-context experimental routes.

claire: what changed under the hood?

talia: priority lanes now use a lightweight priority queue that prefers requests with low KV-entropy and small remaining token budgets, plus a jittered release to smooth bursts. also tightened compatibility checks to avoid expensive KV rehydration during coalesce.

snippet of config we flipped:
```
priority.lanes.enabled = true
priority.jitter_ms = 10
priority.kv_entropy_threshold = 0.25
```

deploy-bot: canary: microkernel-priority-lanes-v3 promoted to default in region-ap-south-1 at 2027-01-12T04:21:00Z :white_check_mark:

omar: any regressions or surprises?

talia: one tenant produced mis-tagged high-entropy requests causing a transient p95 bump (~+8%) for ~6m; fixed with an auto-detect rule. saw a small memory uptick (~1.8%) on older nodes; autoscaler rebalanced. no data loss.

claire: dashboards / runbook / alerts?

talia: dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.com/d/priorityv3
runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/priority-lanes-v3
alerts added: priority.lane.drop.rate, coalesce.unexpected.failures, priority.entropy.detect.rate

talia: policy change: default batching policy for seq<=128 is now "priority-lanes-balanced". teams that need zero-priority behavior can opt out with `route.batching = "no-priority"`.

vik: I'll prep the announcement blurb and create follow-ups: #6021 (opt-out telemetry), #6022 (entropy detector improvements), #6023 (post-rollout perf checklist).

talia: huge thanks to runtime + infra + sres for fast validation. closing thread  ping me if you see >5% p99 regressions.
